name: booking-webapp

dependencies.name: booking-api
dependencies.description: Browses services and availability, and creates/manages bookings.

description: The single-page app both Customers and Staff sign into. Customers browse services, find open slots, and manage their own bookings; Staff define services, set availability and time off, and manage the business's whole calendar. Holds no business logic of its own — every read and write goes through booking-api.
